remarks: Live in the heart of Stamford's sought-after Heywood Heights! This spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath second-floor ranch boasts 1,173 sq. ft. of living space, hardwood floors in kitchen and dining room, and a huge private balcony overlooking peaceful wooded views. The open-concept living and dining areas are perfect for entertaining, while the flexible layout invites you to bring your style and updates to make it truly yours. Enjoy life in a pet-friendly, beautifully maintained community with lush green spaces, a sparkling pool, and unbeatable convenience. Just minutes to shopping, dining, public transportation, Chelsea Piers, and the sandy beaches and trails of Cove Island Park. Don't miss this opportunity to own in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods - come see the potential and fall in love!
